prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE finished standalone PNG game asset for Master of Orion — Reborn. Filename: race-alkari-audience.png. Requested dimensions 1920x1080, 16:9. Input image: approved race leader portrait, visual reference for original species design, believable materials, costume identity and lighting.
Race lore and art direction:
6 · Alkari — Altair — sky blue / white
Game role: ace pilots. Strengths: ships are much harder to hit and act earlier; cheap propulsion research. Weaknesses: weak force-field science; blood feud with the Mrrshan and wary of several others.
Body & dress: raptor-people: hawk/eagle head with hooked beak, layered brown-cream plumage, sharp golden eyes, folded wings or wing-joints at the shoulders (can glide). Elegant flight-officer uniforms tailored around the wings; blue-and-white colours, clan crests, talon-guard bracers, flight goggles pushed up.
Surroundings: high-altitude aeries: cliff-top spires, open-air landing platforms, wind-stirred banners, vaulted windows over cloud seas, perches and rafters inside halls, hangars full of sleek fighters.
Personality: proud, clan-minded, quick, honour-sensitive. Moods: alert/precise → proud contempt → blazing feud-rage (Mrrshan).
Hooks: clan banners of fallen pilots, feathers kept as honours, a wind-tunnel training hall.
Asset purpose: Diplomacy audience background. Create an imposing seat of power: audience hall, throne-office or war room derived from the race surroundings, with spatial depth and homeworld atmosphere.
Composition: No foreground characters: the game composites its existing leader portrait separately. Keep left 45% and bottom 30% dark and calm; architecture, windows, light and visual interest at centre-right.
Visual treatment: photorealistic cinematic hard sci-fi concept still, serious prestige drama, worn lived-in industrial materials, 85mm portrait lens language where appropriate, strong key from left, restrained race-colored rim, deep shadows, subtle film grain, muted filmic grade. Match reference realism and species identity. ONE dominant race accent color. No text, captions, readable glyphs or equations, numbers, watermark, logos, borders, interface, real-world flags or symbols. Small non-text original costume insignia from reference may remain. Avoid cartoon, anime, cel shading, toy, plastic, waxy skin, cute mascot, oversized eyes, rainbow saturation, fantasy armor, medieval costume, malformed hands or duplicated limbs. Full frame is one coherent scene, never a collage.
